title: Rosie O’Donnell rants that Trump-era ICE facilities are concentration camps where inmates are raped
summary: Rosie O'Donnell compared ICE detention facilities to concentration camps in Nazi Germany and suggested Dolly Parton should run the world instead.

title: Spanberger fact-checked after Trump mail-voting warning raises military ballot fears
summary: CNN issued a correction after Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger and Wolf Blitzer suggested Trump's mail-voting rules could impact military voters abroad.

title: Democrats blink in shutdown fight, hand Trump and GOP win before midterms
summary: House Democrats caved on their government shutdown push, but conservatives raged over a hemp ban delay and federal grants provision in the CR.

title: NY Gov Kathy Hochul accuses Trump of 'defunding the police,' says DHS is 'withholding' counterterror funds
summary: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul accused President Donald Trump of "defunding the police," saying that DHS is "withholding" millions of dollars in funding.

title: Majority of Americans reject Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America, poll finds
summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll shows 63% of Americans oppose Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America amid the U.S.-Canada trade war.

title: Trump, Schiff forge unlikely alliance as Hollywood bleeds jobs
summary: President Donald Trump and Adam Schiff find rare common ground on a federal film tax incentive to bring back Hollywood entertainment jobs lost abroad.

title: Massive World Trade Center steel beam arrives at West Point, uniting 9/11 heroes with generation sent to war
summary: A 16,900-pound steel beam from the South Tower of the World Trade Center arrived at West Point as Tunnel to Towers marks 25 years since 9/11.

title: Self-funded CEO claims GOP nomination to challenge Massachusetts Democrat’s second-term bid
summary: Mike Minogue won 70% at the Massachusetts GOP convention and defeated former MBTA executive Brian Shortsleeve to take on Gov. Maura Healey.

title: 80-year-old Dem beats back generational challenge after going all-in on trans athletes
summary: Ed Markey defeated Seth Moulton's generational change campaign by leaning into progressive credentials and taking a bold stance on transgender rights in sports.

title: Travelers warned of murder, kidnappings and drink-spiking robberies in vacation hot spot
summary: The U.S. State Department warns Americans about express kidnappings, drink drugging and armed robbery across Brazil, with Rio de Janeiro flagged specifically.
